title: DGUB hunger strike for viable agriculture

start_date.summary: Reports say strike began on 30 September / Monday preceding 3 October.

end_date.summary: Closure release says ended after eight days but has an internal weekday/date inconsistency; exact end date unresolved.

notes: Hunger strike is an ongoing action, not a public gathering of 50; do not count as an event. Separate solidarity sit-ins are candidates.
